fieldValues.title: Should the affirmed clusters return to the synthesiser?
fieldValues.thinking_reached: No option chosen. Raised as an open question in Research (5. What AI should own: clusters and other dynamic structure), 2026-10-30, and turned into an exercise so options are explored before any decision.
fieldValues.tensions:
Options, none chosen:
- A. Yes: unaffirm all 24 and let the synthesiser own clusters.
- B. Keep names affirmed and membership fluid, as the handbook says today.
- C. The synthesiser owns clusters; the owner can pin one.
fieldValues.unresolved_questions: Whether the synthesiser's clusters beat the frozen ones on the owner's own reading.
fieldValues.next_action: Run the synthesiser on the problems with the 24 clusters hidden and compare.
